Direct Tax Collection Grows 13% to Over ₹13.37 Lakh Crore

Net direct tax collection in India has grown by 13% to ₹13.38 lakh crore as of October 14. This increase is attributed to strong growth in corporate tax and higher refunds for Securities Transaction Tax (STT). The collection represents a 13.21% rise compared to the same period in the previous fiscal year.
